name: Glimmingen - Bjursjon
description: Glimmingen to Bjursjon. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Live-check Vasttrafik planner for Glimmingen, Grorod, Kurod/Skalbanksmuseet and Kopperods viadukt, especially line 738 summer periods and any Nartrafik eligibility for Bjursjon.
Field or manager verification would improve Koperodssjon shelter coordinate, spur access, water status and nearby shooting-range noise caveat.
Treat 2023 Bjursjon portable-toilet/jetty-camping blog report as dated context only until current official confirmation exists.
Commercial/service opening hours at Valkommen in/Shell/7-Eleven and any Uddevalla centre services need live checks if exposed.
De-duplicate repeated coordinates before length, snapping, simplification or route matching.

facilities.name: Glimmingen trailhead information and bus cluster
facilities.description: Stage 13 start cluster with fixed bus access and trailhead information/guidepost context. Model bus stop as access metadata. Suppress any public-transport shelter as a hiking shelter.

facilities.name: Bavean nedre reserve access cluster
facilities.description: Nature reserve/access cluster in Bavean nedre, where Bohusleden passes through early in Stage 13. OSM maps parking nearby; Lansstyrelsen confirms reserve and trails. Reserve fire and tenting restrictions apply. Parking is OSM-confirmed but not source-confirmed as official trailhead parking.

facilities.name: Vindskydd Koperodssjon / Stora Koperodssjon
facilities.description: Official WST wind shelter by Stora Koperodssjon. WST narrative permits rest or overnight; Vindskyddskartan says sleeps 4, water quality unknown and a bit off Bohusleden. OSM tags a lean-to shelter with fireplace=yes. Access is off-route spur; map/signage check advisable. Do not mark as formal campsite.

facilities.name: Skalbanksmuseet / Skalbankarna
facilities.description: Attraction and access cluster at Skalbanksmuseet/Kurods skalbankar, directly on/near the route. Bohuslans museum says Bohusleden passes by, museum toilet is available when open/access allows, and information signs are present on Skalbanksslingan. Museum is closed for the season and opens again June 2026 according to operator page; shell banks remain visitable. Toilet availability is conditional on museum access/opening.

facilities.name: Valkommen in / Shell / 7-Eleven Nordmannerodsvagen
facilities.description: Near-route food/service hub at Nordmannerodsvagen/Shell/7-Eleven. Commercial opening hours must be checked before relying on it.

facilities.name: Bjursjostugan / Motionscentral Bjursjon
facilities.description: Endpoint recreation/trailhead cluster at Bjursjon with parking, toilet, information/activity context, conditional water and seasonal/opening-hours cafe/service context. Water/toilet availability should be treated as opening-hours or operator-dependent until verified. Cafe is seasonal/winter Sunday context from Uddevalla SK and must be live-checked.

facilities.name: Bjursjon endpoint parking
facilities.description: Main endpoint parking near Stage 13/14 boundary. WST gives no capacity; avoid overstating.

facilities.name: Pasholk Bjursjon
facilities.description: Bag box for helping keep nature free of plastic/rubbish. Do not mark as trash/waste disposal.

facilities.name: Bjursjon badplats
facilities.description: Off-route municipal bathing place with sand, jetty, accessible ramp/toilet, grill, benches/tables, dry toilets and waste bins. Dogs are forbidden at the municipal bathing area; dog bathing possible on northeast shore. Bathing-water status does not mean drinking water.

facilities.name: Halligangparken Bjursjon
facilities.description: Outdoor gym/motorikbana cluster with two fixed grill places and no trash bin. No trash bin in park according to Uddevalla; pack out waste. Grill use still depends on current fire bans and signage.
